name: sky-first-scrd-exam-platform
description: Sky First Center for Research and Development web platform and Exam portal

scripts.check: node --check backend_worker.js && node --check public/app.js && node --check EXAM/src/index.js && node --check EXAM/public/api.js && node --check EXAM/public/core.js && node --check EXAM/public/storage.js && node --check EXAM/public/exam.js && node --check EXAM/functions/health.js && node --check tests/release-audit.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:migrations && npm run test:content && npm run test:ui && npm run test:scrd && npm run test:integration && npm run test:exam && npm run test:release
scripts.deploy:scrd: npm run check && npx wrangler@4.34.0 deploy --config wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy:exam: npm run test:exam && npx wrangler@4.34.0 deploy --config EXAM/wrangler.json
